description: This file defines the CloudSearchDomainClient class, a client for interacting with Amazon CloudSearch Domains via AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for searching, suggesting, and uploading documents, with functionality to modify request methods for large queries.

classes.name: CloudSearchDomainClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon CloudSearch Domain operations, providing methods for searching, suggesting, and uploading documents, with request modification capabilities.

methods.name: searchByPost
methods.description: Private method that modifies the request handler to replace GET requests with POST requests for the Search command.

methods.name: convertGetToPost
methods.description: Static method that converts a GET request to a POST request by moving query parameters to the request body, avoiding URL length restrictions.
